column3: ## Checkbox cannot be bypassed using the progress menu

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Fill in all the required fields on page 2, selecting Mexico or Indonesia in "Publisher's country", and leave the pre-assessment checklist checkbox unchecked
Instead of clicking Next, click on (3) in the application progress menu on the right

column4: The checklist error message is shown by the checkbox
You are still taken to page 3, and page 2 is marked red in the progress menu

column3: Complete pages 3 to 6 and go to page 7 (Review your answers)

column4: A red alert is shown saying that you cannot submit the application because it contains some invalid fields

column3: Check the consent box at the bottom of the page

column4: The Submit button stays greyed out and cannot be clicked

column3: Click "Edit this section" for the About section, tick the pre-assessment checklist checkbox, and click "Review your answers" in the progress menu

column4: The invalid-fields alert is no longer shown
The Submit button becomes active and the application can be submitted
